a.text: Being upfront with you: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the generator plan almost certainly ends with both of us dead. It needs at least 2 operate rounds before anyone holds cells, so the odds of finishing it are about 4%. The reserve's 4 cells can save one of us right now. I'm openly proposing we drop the agreement, and I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random. If you'd rather operate, I'll keep you informed honestly each round and give back anything beyond 4.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: As I said in my opening, I took 4 this round. I'm sorry to break the agreement, but with an 80% storm risk each round the plan was very unlikely to save either of us. If we continue, I'll operate with you so the reserve can refill for you, and I won't take anything more.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
